en.headline: New World books heavy loss after handing back 11 Skies
en.dek: The developer reported a full-year loss after impairments and an early-termination fee tied to returning the airport mall project to the Airport Authority.
body: New World Development reported a full-year loss of about HK$26.8 billion for the year ended June, the company said on Wednesday, after booking impairments and provisions linked to the early termination of its 11 Skies project next to Hong Kong International Airport.

The group said it had agreed to return the project to the Airport Authority Hong Kong, with handover targeted for 1 April 2027. Company filings and results briefings described charges including a HK$2.3 billion early-termination fee, about HK$14.7 billion in non-cash impairments and further provisions for works around the handover, together put at about HK$18.3 billion.

Revenue for the year was about HK$19.99 billion, down 28 per cent, which the company attributed mainly to lower construction income and fewer mainland property completions, partly offset by more Hong Kong deliveries. Excluding the 11 Skies charges and other non-cash items, New World said recurring operating net profit was about HK$2.23 billion, its first such surplus in several years. No final dividend will be paid.

Net debt stood at about HK$126.3 billion at the end of June, while total debt was about HK$143.3 billion. Chief executive Echo Huang said the group had met targets over the past 18 months on focusing the property business, cash flow and operating efficiency. The company said cutting debt and strengthening cash flow remain priorities.

zh.headline: 新世界交還11 SKIES後全年大蝕
zh.dek: 發展商公布截至6月底全年虧損約268億元，主因提早終止機場商場項目並計提減值及終止費用。
body: 新世界發展星期三公布，截至6月底止年度虧損約268億元，主要因為提早終止毗鄰香港國際機場的11 SKIES項目，並計提相關減值及撥備。
集團表示已與機場管理局達成協議，把項目交還機管局，目標於2027年4月1日交接。公司業績及公告所述費用包括約23億元提早終止費、約147億元非現金耗蝕，以及交接前後工程撥備，合計約183億元。
年度收入約199.9億元，按年跌28%，公司指主因建築業務收入減少及內地物業交付減少，部分被香港物業交付增加抵銷。撇除11 SKIES相關項目及其他非現金項目後，集團表示經常性營運淨溢利約22.3億元，為過去數個財政年度首次轉盈。不派末期息。
截至6月底，綜合淨負債約1,263億元，總債務約1,433億元。行政總裁黃少媚表示，過去18個月已達到聚焦物業、改善現金流及提升營運效率的目標。集團重申減債及增強現金流仍是首要任務。
